name: RC-B10-0126/2025 – § 9 – Am 1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on repression by the Ortega-Murillo regime in Nicaragua, targeting human rights defenders, political opponents and religious communities in particular
part_text: 9. Calls for the immediate extradition of Alessio Casimirri, an Italian who is currently living in Managua under the protection of the Nicaraguan Government, to Italy, where he has been given six definitive life sentences for the kidnapping and murder of Aldo Moro, the former Italian Prime Minister, President of the European Council and leader of the Christian Democracy party, and for the murder of his guards, in 1978;
